projection.d3: d3.geoConicEqualArea().parallels([19.2, 19.7]).rotate([99.15, 0]).center([0, 19.43]).fitExtent([[pad, pad], [width - pad, height - pad]], frame)
projection.frame: GeoJSON Polygon of meta.view (CDMX plus a margin) for the initial fit, or meta.bbox for the whole drawing; ring closed clockwise, e.g. [[w,n],[e,n],[e,s],[w,s],[w,n]]
projection.winding: Exterior rings clockwise, holes anticlockwise (d3-geo convention; opposite to RFC 7946). Rewind if you draw with a planar library that cares.
